title: AddStair Command
description: Add a straight stair: one closed sawtooth solid on A-STAIR with forsk:kind=stair and forsk:id S01, S02. Risers = ceil(rise / riser_max), all exactly equal, treads = risers - 1, run = treads x going. Place it with from and to (the foot of the first riser on the stair's centre line, then a point it climbs toward), or along_wall / wall_id (along that wall's room side, from the end nearer at), or give nothing (along the longest room wall that holds the run). rise omitted or "auto" is floor to floor (the walls' most common height plus the floor slab) and follows the walls when they are baked again. A size outside the comfort rule (2R+G 600-640, riser 180 or less, width 800 or more) still builds; the message says so.

from.description: Foot of the first riser [x, y], model mm, on the stair's centre line.

to.description: A point the stair climbs toward [x, y], model mm.

along_wall.description: Run along the one picked wall's room side.

wall_id.description: Run along this wall's room side.

side.description: With along_wall or wall_id: which run of a record that holds several.

at.description: The stair starts at the wall end nearer this point [x, y].

riser_max.description: Highest step allowed, mm, default 180. The risers come out at or under it, all equal.

against.description: With from and to: the side of the stair that stands against a wall, looking up it.

rise.description: Total rise in mm, or auto (default): floor to floor from the walls.
